text: Does anyone have the link to the new travel policy? No rush.
reply_text:
I couldn't find a travel policy link for Hollis, and I've told them so in our DM.

I searched the brain and the shared files, and read #general, #help-it-ops and #central-team. None of them mention a travel policy. #general and #help-it-ops came back empty. I didn't open #central-random or #inc-tansley-carrier-api, which are a social channel and an incident room. Hollis is in every channel I checked, so I didn't look at anything they can't see themselves.

I suggested they ask in #general or check with whoever owns HR and ops policies. I also offered to find the link if it gets posted somewhere I can see.
